question: ¿Qué sector tiene el mayor porcentaje de su monto en órdenes de trato directo?
final_sql: WITH trato_directo AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS total_ordenes_trato_directo, SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS monto_total_trato_directo FROM oc_lineas WHERE EsTratoDirecto = 'Si' GROUP BY sector), total_sector AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS total_ordenes, SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS monto_total FROM oc_lineas GROUP BY sector) SELECT t.sector, (t.monto_total_trato_directo / ts.monto_total) * 100 AS porcentaje_monto_trato_directo FROM trato_directo AS t JOIN total_sector AS ts ON t.sector = ts.sector ORDER BY porcentaje_monto_trato_directo DESC LIMIT 1
advisory: order_level_aggregate_over_lines: SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) agrega un valor de nivel orden que se repite en cada línea. Deduplica primero por codigo en un CTE que traiga TODO lo que necesitas, una fila por orden: WITH o AS (SELECT codigo, any_value(<monto>) AS monto, any_value(<columna para filtrar o agrupar>) AS ... FROM ... WHERE ... GROUP BY codigo) y agrega sobre o, sin volver a unir con la tabla de líneas
attempt_sql:
WITH trato_directo AS (
    SELECT 
        sector,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS total_ordenes_trato_directo,
        SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS monto_total_trato_directo
    FROM 
        oc_lineas
    WHERE 
        EsTratoDirecto = 'Si'
    GROUP BY 
        sector
),
total_sector AS (
    SELECT 
        sector,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS total_ordenes,
        SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS monto_total
    FROM 
        oc_lineas
    GROUP BY 
        sector
)
SELECT 
    t.sector,
    (t.monto_total_trato_directo / ts.monto_total) * 100 AS porcentaje_monto_trato_directo
FROM 
    trato_directo t
JOIN 
    total_sector ts ON t.sector = ts.sector
ORDER BY 
    porcentaje_monto_trato_directo DESC
LIMIT 1;
